newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 28.816 bln lvs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 28.816 bln lvs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Wednesday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.83 percent and 17.76 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 28.816 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all of them.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 14,856.2 million levs 13,960 million levs
Bids approved 14,856.2 million levs 13,960 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.83 pct 17.76 pct @
